incidents.name: Midas Capital jarvisFRAX3CRV precision loss
incidents.notes: The Midas cToken's exchange-rate maths loses precision on a market with very few outstanding shares, so donating collateral rounded the redeem/borrow accounting in the attacker's favour and let them over-borrow the pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim market 0xf8527dc5611b589cbb365acacaac0d1dc70b25cb created 2023-04-13T05:56:04Z by 0x27521eae4ee4153214cadc3ecd703b9b0326c908, unrelated to attack sender 0x4b92cc3452ef1e37528470495b86d3f976470734; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the market (it uses Compound's own NewImplementation instead - see the recheck below). The exploit transaction moved 274,358.98 BUSD and 1,077.93 WBNB through 0x85faac652b707fdf6907ef726751087f9e0b6687; lossUsd uses the ~$600K stated in the Midas post-mortem. Recheck (deployment basis was wrong, by a wide margin): the market is a Midas CErc20Delegator whose fallback delegatecalls `implementation` at storage slot 0 and, through the implementation's DiamondExtension fallback, a registered extension. Its own 618-byte runtime never changed (identical keccak(eth_getCode) at creation block 27304205 and incident block 29185769), but binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 0 over [27304205, 29185768] finds six implementation swaps after deployment: 0x62473df8 (creation) -> 0x74517010 (block 27392990, 2023-04-16) -> 0x8e156d3c (27539708, 2023-04-21) -> 0xb8729ec6 (27543808, 2023-04-21) -> 0x13a2eb85 (28121136, 2023-05-11) -> 0x1d48efba (28886223, 2023-06-07) -> 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 (29067669, 2023-06-13T14:21:12Z). The market's NewImplementation(address,address) log series matches the storage search block for block, and the diamond extension slot (extensions[0] at keccak(keccak("diamond.standard.diamond.storage")+2)) was rewritten to 0xe4fea88df81eba4f579208fa5abeb10aaf84e3f4 in that same block 29067669. Both addresses are exactly the two the victim delegatecalls in the exploit trace. The exploited exchange-rate code was therefore 4.1 days old, not the 65.5 days the deployment basis gave.

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2023-06-13T14:21:12Z (BSC block 29067669): the CErc20Delegator's implementation (CDelegationStorage slot 0) changed 0x1d48efba40d11c22315dd278e69268bca9dd5d7d -> 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 and, in the same block, the market's registered diamond extension changed 0x2a8c6f2ddf8cb3d82407a07dc795f095a3ad8a0f -> 0xe4fea88df81eba4f579208fa5abeb10aaf84e3f4; found by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 0 and on keccak(keccak("diamond.standard.diamond.storage")+2) (extensions[0]), and corroborated by the market's own NewImplementation(address,address) event
